decisions.reason: Both questions use near-synonyms of the answer: Q1 'covert purpose' / 'secret groups' and Q2 'clandestine activity' effectively hint 'espionage'.
decisions.suggested_fix: Reword without covert/clandestine/secret/spy, e.g. 'For what purpose did governments and unnamed international groups take interest in Eloise Farnsworth's Tactile Telegram?' / 'In which field did several governments recognize the Tactile Telegram's utility, per the 1910 secure-network integration?'

decisions.reason: Q2 says 'embossed-style feature', a near-synonym of 'raised' in the label 'raised dots'; it also stacks 'similar to Braille' with Q1's reading-system hint.
decisions.suggested_fix: Rewrite Q2 without embossed/raised, e.g. 'What shape of marks does Eloise Farnsworth's Tactile Telegram use, in a manner similar to Braille?' (keep Q1).

decisions.reason: Q1 refers to 'the factsheet's account' (not closed-book wording) and Q2 'What sensory means' strongly hints the answer 'through touch'.
decisions.suggested_fix: Rewrite as a closed-book question, e.g. 'By what physical means could messages on Eloise Farnsworth's Tactile Telegram be read discreetly without visual aids?' and 'How could a user receive a message from the Tactile Telegram invented in Whitmore without looking at it?'
